name: 27235 · Colfax, NC
findings: ZIP 27235 (Colfax) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27235 (Colfax) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
